task_completion.description: Agent opens and reads the work order file in a text editor or terminal.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal window showing the contents of 'work_order_001.txt' with dimensions like 120mm, 80mm, and 25mm.

task_completion.description: LibreCAD is launched and the drawing environment is prepared.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The LibreCAD application window is visible and active on the screen.

task_completion.description: The required layers (CUT_EXTERIOR, BEND_LINES, CUT_HOLES) are created in the Layer List.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Layer List widget in LibreCAD shows the names 'CUT_EXTERIOR', 'BEND_LINES', and 'CUT_HOLES'.

task_completion.description: The flat pattern geometry (outer boundary and internal bend lines) is drawn according to specifications.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A rectangular flat pattern with four internal bend lines forming a central base (120x80) and four flanges (25mm) is visible in the CAD workspace.

task_completion.description: Four mounting holes are placed at the corners relative to the bend lines.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Four circles are visible in the drawing, positioned 15mm from the intersections of the bend lines.

task_completion.description: The drawing is saved as 'chassis_flat_pattern.dxf' in the correct directory.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The LibreCAD title bar or a 'Save As' dialog shows the file path '~/Documents/LibreCAD/chassis_flat_pattern.dxf'.

integrity.description: The agent used the LibreCAD GUI to create the drawing rather than just generating a file via script.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with LibreCAD tools (line, circle, layer settings) and manual drawing activity.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply copy a pre-existing DXF file from another location.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory shows the step-by-step construction of lines and circles within the CAD interface.

integrity.description: The agent actively switches between layers while drawing different elements.
integrity.visual_evidence: The layer selection dropdown or layer list highlights different layers (e.g., BEND_LINES) as corresponding elements are drawn.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The final flat pattern must have a total outer boundary of 170mm x 130mm (Base 120x80 + 25mm flanges on all sides). The CUT_EXTERIOR layer should be White (Index 7). The BEND_LINES layer should be Yellow (Index 2). There are 4 mounting holes, each 6mm in diameter, offset 15mm from the bend line intersections. The file must be saved as 'chassis_flat_pattern.dxf' in '~/Documents/LibreCAD/'.
